manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve a bounded official homepage case where current-code PDF discovery crawls successfully but finds no PDF candidates.
search_queries: 東京モード学園 修学支援
東京モード学園 機関要件確認申請書
steps: Start from the official school homepage URL https://www.mode.ac.jp/tokyo.
Run strict FY2026 PDF discovery against the seeded school_site URL with discovery_method=discovery_gold_set.
Observe that the crawler completes without a site fetch error and emits no_candidates_found for the same URL.
Classify the result as no_target_candidate_found so the operator can distinguish a crawlable no-PDF path from site infrastructure failure or old-year publication lag.

reusable_rules: Treat no_candidates_found as a first-class outcome when the official URL was fetched successfully but no PDF links were discoverable.
Keep this bucket separate from site_fetch_error because the site itself was reachable.
Use this bucket to route the school to manual URL entry or official-index follow-up instead of accepting a non-target substitute.
anti_patterns: Do not weaken the release gate by dropping no_target_candidate_found coverage.
Do not relabel a crawlable no-PDF homepage as publication_lag_latest_public without an old-year target PDF.
Do not broaden to mass SERP from the agent harness just because the official homepage has no PDF candidates.

evidence.notes: Current-code bounded replay on 2026-05-12 seeded the official homepage and produced no_candidates_found for school_id 4 with no downloaded PDFs.
